mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, reducing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending confidence and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 3-month year-over-year growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 2% indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS YoY growth exceed 2%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), a decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 12-month MA and CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) relative to the prior quarter compresses recession risk and supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a monthly payroll employment increase exceeding 100,000 persons signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000 and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline exceeding 5% from the prior month signals weakening consumer demand, reducing retail sales and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls > 5%.
